difficulty_reason: Base change by k'/k via the faithfully flat Spec(k' ⊗ k') makes the hypothesis independent of the representing point; reduce to Spec(k) -> Z_x surjective flat lfp, where Z_x = [Spec(k)/R] with R = Spec(k) x_X Spec(k) (improve-unique-point construction); the hypothesis gives R = Spec(k) x_Y Spec(k), so residual-gerbe-functorial's map is fully faithful by map-space-into-stack, and residual-gerbe-unique finishes.
